selection_policy: 1-3 documented representative choices per part, not a measured market-share ranking. Unknown contact and assembly data are not filled by arbitrary material constants.

BE2013_T1.title: Vibroacoustics of the piano soundboard: Reduced models, mobility synthesis, and acoustical radiation regime
BE2013_T1.location: Table 1, PDF page 8; material axes paragraph below table
BE2013_T1.evidence: Published piano-model material inputs tracing Sitka to Berthaut, Norway and maple to Haines; no common specimen moisture condition reported in table.
BE2013_T1.conditions: Bulk material values used by this paper. Not identified properties of Keyra references or a finished crowned/ribbed soundboard.
BE2013_T1.redistribution: Paper not bundled. Only bibliographic metadata and factual numerical inputs are recorded.

USDA2010_T5_3.title: Wood Handbook: Wood as an Engineering Material, FPL-GTR-190
USDA2010_T5_3.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Forest Products Laboratory
USDA2010_T5_3.location: Table 5-3a, metric rows Basswood American and Spruce Sitka, 12% moisture; specific-gravity footnote b
USDA2010_T5_3.evidence: Clear-specimen handbook averages. Bending modulus includes shear deflection; not an axial modulus or measured assembled key.
USDA2010_T5_3.conditions: 12% moisture content; specific gravity uses oven-dry mass and volume at 12% moisture.
USDA2010_T5_3.derivation: Density at MC = SG_MC * 1000 kg/m3 * (1+MC). Thus 448 and 414.4 kg/m3; SG*1000 alone would be oven-dry mass per current specimen volume.
USDA2010_T5_3.retrieval: Official indexed table excerpt verified; direct full-PDF download returned HTTP403, so no downloaded-byte hash claimed.
USDA2010_T5_3.redistribution: US federal publication; full book not bundled.

AST44_2023_T1.title: Vibration analysis of piano strings involving dynamics of hammer shanks
AST44_2023_T1.evidence: Published piano-string calculation inputs; do not call these a measured Keyra wire specimen.
AST44_2023_T1.conditions: Paper model values; wire temper and moisture do not determine wound-string slip losses.

CDA_C11000.title: C11000 alloy physical properties
CDA_C11000.location: Physical properties: specific gravity, modulus of elasticity in tension, modulus of rigidity
CDA_C11000.conditions: Density at 68 F (20 C); typical bulk C11000 values, not measured piano winding grade.
CDA_C11000.retrieval: Official indexed data verified; direct page fetch returned403.
CDA_C11000.redistribution: No page text or images bundled.

ROHM_PMMA_GS.title: PLEXIGLAS mechanical properties FAQ / Soundstop XT technical information
ROHM_PMMA_GS.location: FAQ mechanical properties of GS; same bulk values corroborated by official XT technical table
ROHM_PMMA_GS.conditions: Typical PMMA sheet material, not an identified piano-keytop formulation. No skin friction/contact stiffness is inferred.

YAMAHA_WOODS.title: A Brief Guide to Piano Tonewoods
YAMAHA_WOODS.location: Soundboard, Bridge, Rim, Keys and Hammers sections
YAMAHA_WOODS.evidence: Construction evidence supports spruce soundboards; maple/maple-beech bridges; maple or beech rims; spruce and basswood key sticks. This is not a frequency-of-use survey or material-property measurement.
YAMAHA_WOODS.redistribution: No article text or images bundled.

YAMAHA_ACTION.title: Making the Keyboard and Action
YAMAHA_ACTION.evidence: Documents acrylic keytops, felt-lined bushings and wool hammerfelt. Numerical contact properties remain unmeasured.
YAMAHA_ACTION.redistribution: No article text or images bundled.

YAMAHA_STRINGS.title: YUS Series features / Stringing and Mounting the Keyboard and Action
YAMAHA_STRINGS.evidence: Construction evidence for steel piano strings and copper-wound bass strings. Exact winding grade and geometry are not supplied.
YAMAHA_STRINGS.redistribution: No article text or images bundled.

FELT_HYSTERESIS1995.title: Hysteretic model of the grand piano hammer felt
FELT_HYSTERESIS1995.author: Anatoli Stulov
FELT_HYSTERESIS1995.evidence: Experimental force-compression behavior requires history dependence. Material name alone does not specify stiffness/exponent/relaxation.

FELT_EXPERIMENT1984.title: Dynamic compression characteristics of piano hammer felt
FELT_EXPERIMENT1984.evidence: Simultaneous hammer/string displacement and striking force measurement. Loading/unloading are not interchangeable fixed stiffness laws.

NPL_DRY_AIR.title: Speed of Sound Toilet Roll Report
NPL_DRY_AIR.evidence: Dry ideal-gas sound-speed approximation c approximately 20.047 sqrt(T_K). Humidity changes sound speed; humid-air attenuation is outside that approximation.

UNSW_HELMHOLTZ.title: Helmholtz Resonance
UNSW_HELMHOLTZ.evidence: A circular thin aperture with two flanged ends has an approximate1.7r end correction. Other geometries and flexible bodies require different modeling.

HAMBRIC2007_EQ7.title: Structural Acoustics Tutorial, Part2: Sound-Structure Interaction
HAMBRIC2007_EQ7.evidence: Low-ka force/velocity resistance rho*c*A*(ka)^2/2; converting to pressure/volume-velocity divides by A squared. Not an arbitrary open piano lid model.

PLAYER_POSTURE2021.title: Effect of body posture on sound absorption by human subjects
PLAYER_POSTURE2021.evidence: Room-scale measurements establish posture/clothing dependence. They do not provide the complex nearfield impedance of a pianist at Keyra microphone positions.

UNIDENTIFIED_LID.missing: Piano-specific lid species/laminate layup, thickness, mobility and radiation/reflectivity.
